errors.busctl_missing: busctl is required but was not found on PATH

player_filter_mode.label: Player Filter Mode
player_filter_mode.description: Ignore or only allow matching players.

player_filter_list.label: Player Filter Rules
player_filter_list.description: Case-insensitive substring rules matched against player identity and desktop entry.

primary_source.label: Preferred Online Source
primary_source.description: Tried first when fetching lyrics online. Others are used as fallback.

prefer_player_lyrics.label: Prefer Player-Embedded Lyrics
prefer_player_lyrics.description: If the player exposes lyrics over MPRIS (e.g. xesam:asText), use them before NetEase/QQ/LRCLib.

timeout.label: Network Timeout
timeout.description: Abort a lyrics request after this many milliseconds (also used for related encrypt steps).

advance.label: Lyric Timing Offset
advance.description: Milliseconds to shift lyrics earlier (positive) or later (negative). Usually leave at 0.

show_secondary_line.label: Show Translation / Romanization
show_secondary_line.description: Under the main lyric, show a smaller dimmer line for translation or romanization when the source provides it (NetEase/QQ).

secondary_line_content.label: Extra Line Content
secondary_line_content.description: What the smaller line under the lyric should show.

bar_width.label: Max Width
bar_width.description: Maximum width in adaptive mode, or locked width in fixed mode (px).

bar_width_mode.label: Width Mode
bar_width_mode.description: Adaptive follows lyric length; fixed keeps a constant width.

bar_hide.label: Hide When Idle
bar_hide.description: Hide this widget when no track is active.

bar_dot.label: Status Dot
bar_dot.description: Colored dot before the lyric for loading/ready/error state.

secondary_primary_font_size.label: Main Lyric Size (when extra line is on)
secondary_primary_font_size.description: Font size of the main lyric while the extra line is visible.

secondary_font_size.label: Extra Line Font Size
secondary_font_size.description: Font size of the translation/romanization line.

secondary_line_gap.label: Gap Between Main and Extra Line
secondary_line_gap.description: Vertical spacing between the two lines. Negative values pull them closer (can reduce clipping on short bars).

secondary_opacity.label: Extra Line Opacity
secondary_opacity.description: How strong the extra line looks (30 = faint, 100 = full).

padding_left.label: Left Padding
padding_left.description: Space inside the capsule on the left (px).

padding_right.label: Right Padding
padding_right.description: Space inside the capsule on the right (px).

text_align.label: Text Alignment
text_align.description: Left / center / right for lyric text. Clearest with fixed width when text is ellipsized.
